caption: The drawing depicts a single figure wearing a costume. The costume consists of an oversized head with a white face, red triangular markings above the eyes, red circles on the cheeks, blue eyes, and a large, broad red mouth; the head also features a white ruffled collar around the neck. The figure is dressed in a red and white vertically striped outfit, comprising a long top and matching pants that are loose-fitting. The hands are covered with oversized beige mittens. The legs are clad in light purple socks or stockings, and the feet are in brown shoes each adorned with a blue pom-pom on the toe. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or elements in the scene. The name "George J. File" is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Jim the Boxer
